cc:Work.dc:title: A phase-robust finite-mode Morse contract
cc:Work.dc:description: For fixed M, Q2<=1/2 localizes exactly two critical points, gives a uniform curvature zone and a normalized F away gap greater than 1/12. For W=e^{-y}F on 0<=y<=1, the formal shape constants are C0=81 and C1=36. In the 1:2 slice, the exact caustic has radius between 1/4 and 1/2, while the general contract occupies the strictly interior disk |z|<=1/8.
